title: Keto Algerian Burdock Stew
description: Hearty and flavorful Algerian-inspired stew made with burdock, gobo, and a blend of spices, perfect for a low-carb keto diet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the burdock and gobo, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the keto stew seasoning blend, chicken broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
